description: 24 Solution is a one-stop platform for property maintenance and technician services. With an end-to-end computerised management system, it ensures price transparency, quality service, and efficient management for Thailand’s fragmented property maintenance market.

9 Degrees Freedom uses a smart sensor and accompanying mobile app (for iOS and Android) to deliver real-time stroke data and visual insights so players can improve their performance on the tennis court.
Ack3 provides network security, anchored on voice biometrics as a key security factor, offering banks and other high-security institutions unparalleled security.

Ackcio is building a proprietary real-time wireless monitoring solution that can connect to any existing industrial sensors through their flexible transmission capability, transmitting data with better coverage, more reliably and more cost efficiently under high stress environments.

Adatos leverages AI and remote sensing technology to improve crop identification, assess nutrient levels, and boost crop yields. The platform provides actionable insights for land and ecosystem analysis, including carbon credit accounting.

Advance offers two key products: salary advances and payroll finance. It allows employees to access their earned wages on demand through a flexible, revolving line of credit, with loan payments automated via salary deductions to minimise risk.

Advano develops and sells anode materials for electric vehicles (EVs) and consumer electronics. Their facility can produce 10 tons of materials per year, and they’re currently working on pilot-scale production and delivery to customers.
Advent Integra builds and operates SIP communication (VoIP, IM) and IPTV-based content delivery platform for service providers addressing the overseas migrant worker market.
Aiah uses a combination of Chatbots and Robotic Process Automation to automate repetitive tasks for companies in Leads Generation and Transaction Automation

AIM Biotech develops 3D human biology-on-a-chip systems to transform drug discovery and clinical decision making, offering the world’s most scientifically validated microphysiological systems (MPS) platform.

Aliena is a Singapore-based space technology company that develops low-power propulsion systems suitable for small satellites and constellations and deployed at low earth orbits (LEO) or very-low earth orbits (VLEO).

AOneSchools is a dual-sided SaaS platform for learning centres and parents. It helps learning centres to schedule their lessons and teachers to manage student enrollment and attendance. It also handles teacher payroll and student payment collection.
Aonic (formerly Poladrone) is an all-in-one drone solutions provider for enterprises that are looking to modernise and streamline workflows in the agricultural, industrial, and retail sectors.

Arcstone is a digital manufacturing solutions provider that enhances operational efficiency, data use, and future planning for SMEs and large enterprises through scalable digitalisation and real-time supply chain visibility.
Ardent is a venture capital firm and builder that targets the Southeast Asian market.
Art Of Click is a performance-based DSP, mobile ad network and media agency, operating primarily in Asia Pacific

Ascenda is one of the world’s leading growth engines for financial institutions and merchants, offering a comprehensive suite of tools that range from standard rewards programmes to intelligent marketing systems.

AssetFindr empowers businesses with real-time visibility and control over their assets. Their software solutions, including the AssetFindr Core Module and Optimax suite, streamline asset management and maintenance, driving efficiency and informed decision-making.

Atomionics is pioneering cold atom interferometry quantum sensing for highly precise gravity measurements. Their miniaturised solution offers 1,000x more accuracy, 100x faster data rates, and uses 70% less power compared to existing technologies.
Attonics develops miniature, ultra-fast, and cost-effective spectrometers for colour sensing and quality control functions, tailored for industrial automation and manufacturing.
Aureso digitises and automates car sales management by providing tools for sales and vehicle management, CRM, data analytics and financing & leasing.
Bambu is a leading global provider of digital wealth technology for businesses of every size and industry, from finance to commercial or even new disruptors, transforming the digital wealth market.

Bazaar Tech offers a platform enabling retailers (Kiryanas) to streamline volume management, access real-time insights, and avail of financial services. It also helps retailers discover suppliers with better margins, acquire customers, and manage operations through various apps.
Beams is an AI-powered tool designed to create and analyse safety reports in the aviation industry, offering insights to minimise risks and improve overall safety.

Beppo is a bookkeeping solution for small and medium-sized businesses across the Philippines. Their accounting app is well-suited for SMEs, and their end-to-end AI-powered service ensures affordable yet effective bookkeeping.

Bifrost is an AI-powered, synthetic data generation platform for development teams to create high-fidelity, 3D synthetic environment datasets in just a couple of hours–significantly faster and cheaper than traditional methods.

iBIND Systems automates infrastructure for financial institutions, expediting corporate client onboarding. Their platform enables the creation, storage, reuse, and verification of KYC data, identity information, digital signatures, and e-documents, greatly improving efficiency.

Blaize specializes in AI edge computing, providing high-efficiency, low-latency hardware and software platforms for real-time AI applications at the edge. Their technology is faster and more efficient than traditional GPU/CPU solutions​.
Bondle is a unique productivity tool that securely integrates workflow, documents & messaging providing deep insights into processes and a new way to do enterprise communication.

Borneo is a modular cybersecurity platform designed for hyper-growth businesses. It provides autonomous real-time visibility, assessment, and remediation to reduce security and compliance risks throughout the entire data lifecycle.

Bridge provides HR Payroll solutions to companies and uses this as a foundation for financial services such as payday loans, savings, and other financial products in the future. City governments in the Philippines are also using the Bridge platform to manage city-wide loan and financial assistance programs.

BridgeLinx Technologies is a Pakistani company dedicated to optimising last-mile delivery services. It has developed a digital freight marketplace in Pakistan that helps shippers and carriers manage everything, from booking to settlement.
Caarly connects automobile dealerships with consumers through an online platform

Canal Circle provides financial institutions and brand partners with bespoke technology solutions, that channel the delivery of a wide array of financial services and essential products to end customers.

Checkmate offers a comprehensive solution that consolidates all pre-employment tasks. By automating background and referral checks, Checkmate dramatically reduces the time HR managers spend on each application.

CNV offers a suite of loyalty and e-commerce digitisation tools that help MSMEs engage in e-commerce and marketing activities on major customer-facing platforms such as Zalo mini-apps, own apps, Facebook Messenger, and SMS. Powered by its Customer Data Platform, CNV enables clients to effectively engage customers, drive revenue, and boost engagement–all while collecting and categorising valuable data to create detailed individual customer profiles.
Coins.ph delivers financial services over mobile to people in Southeast Asia who are currently underserved by traditional banks.
Credibook wants to make debt management easier for small and medium-sized enterprises.
CreoPop sells the world’s first 3D pen using cool ink. The device has no hot parts or melting plastic.
CtrlWorks develops robotics systems to give autonomous guidance capability to any mobility platform.

Cube Asia offers granular market data and insights for e-commerce, specifically catering to online-focused FMCG and retail companies. They specialise in live commerce platforms like TikTok and popular Asian e-commerce sites like Shopee and Lazada.
CIH is a cyber intelligence company that specializes in digital risk protection.

Dat Bike manufactures high-performance electric bikes and was recognised by the Vietnam Ministry of Transportation for the first “Made-in-Vietnam” electric bike. It is also the only one in the market that can rival gas bikes in terms of performance.
DCX is a digital rice trading platform that enables trading stakeholders to discover each other, compare and negotiate offers, and execute deals.
Doxcheck’s document seals provide quick and accurate identity verification through its QR code system with digital documents stored in a secured and centralised authentication facility.
Eazy is a platform that empowers insurance companies to digitise their operations and boost sales, driving efficiency and performance.

ecoSPIRITS provides wine and spirits producers and distributors the world’s first circular packaging technology and low-carbon footprint, last-mile spirits distribution system. Their goal is to eliminate the use of single-use glass packaging.

Eezee is a B2B procurement platform that integrates directly with ERP systems to streamline MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) and indirect spending. As a master merchant, it reduces procurement efforts while leveraging economies of scale.
eFishery is the largest digital cooperative chain for fish/shrimp farmers, providing affordable financing, inputs, and fair market access by leveraging IoT, AI, and a proprietary data platform

Ematic Solutions is a marketing and tech consultancy that enhances the effectiveness of email marketing and its ability to generate revenue. By using AI and ML, the company improves lead generation, engagement, and conversion rates for businesses.
Engagespark is a mobile engagement platform which enables businesses of all sizes to engage with their customers and employees at scale through their mobile phones without the need for mobile data.

Entropica Labs developed a quantum computing software, creating models, algorithms, and tools to make quantum computing practical. Their software helps quantum developers write algorithms with quantum-error correction.

ESGpedia is a one-stop digital platform that provides holistic ESG data and solutions, helping financial institutions, corporates, and SMEs across Asia achieve their sustainability goals. They also offer a comprehensive registry of ESG certifications for companies such as banks.
Evrima is a clinical trial recruitment platform that connects all stakeholders to create a transparent and streamlined clinical trial experience for everyone.

Exborders is a cross-border e-commerce platform giving international merchants access to the top marketplaces in India. They handle all aspects of the import and logistics of shipping goods from the US and Asia into India at prices cheaper than any of the established logistics companies (UPS, DFL Fedex etc.). International merchants can stock their merchandise at an Exborders fulfilment centre, shortening delivery times to a week and allowing customs clearance in 8 hours.
Eyeron is an online optical store which utilises AR for customers to be able to try out glasses

Fasal is building an end-to-end platform for progressive horticulture farmers. It started off with an IoT sensor-aggregator hardware to optimise crop yield and has since expanded to selling inputs and offtaking outputs.

FastDetect provides an innovative point-of-care (POC) RT-PCR testing instrument that can detect active infection in COVID-19 and other diseases, with very high sensitivity (99+%) and specificity (99+%).
Fit Hub is a tech-enabled, hyperlocal gym that offers a premium yet affordable fitness experience, conveniently located close to offices and residential areas in Indonesia.

Flixstock leverages generative AI to help large fashion brands create high-quality fashion model images. This innovative solution provides a cost-effective alternative to expensive model photoshoots and generic stock images, serving clients globally.

Foodmap is Vietnam’s leading agritech company, offering a one-stop destination for high-quality food products. They provide everything from fresh fruits to processed kitchen staples, through Modern Trade (MT), General Trade (GT), Direct-to-Consumer (D2C), third-party e-commerce, and export.
Formative, previously PicoCandy, is building bots for Facebook Workplace.

Gapai is building a credible, trustworthy digital recruitment agency and platform for Indonesian workers seeking overseas employment. It offers foreign job listings, assistance with administrative and interview preparation, and upskilling classes–all within a single platform.

GerWeiss Motors manufactures electric tricycles and builds ecosystems around them, offering leasing options to drivers for a fixed daily fee. Their innovative battery swapping system enables on-the-go recharging, addressing public transportation issues in the Philippines.
Gimmie provides digital marketing tools to acquire, convert and retain more customers on web and mobile.

Giveplease offers an integrated payments and donor management solution designed for the highly neglected non-profit and religious giving sectors, which have struggled to digitise their donation collection processes due to a lack of suitable platforms.

Giztix is an online logistics platform providing full truckload (FTL) bookings, instant price comparisons, and real-time tracking. It connects shippers with carriers, ensuring efficient, transparent, and reliable transportation solutions.
Glints is Southeast Asia’s leading talent platform, connecting employers to a vast network of 120 million professionals through its suite of recruitment tools and a skills education ecosystem.
Glissade is producing a low cost Intra-Oral Dental Scanner (IODS) that is higher in accuracy, touch based and significantly easier to use compared to incumbent scanners in the market.

GoEden is a first-party marketplace for agricultural inputs, supplies, and services in the Philippines. With over 65 suppliers and more than 3,500 products, GoEden offers nationwide access to essential farming resources.
GoZayaan allows users to book domestic and international travel options and pay in their local currency. They also offer the Hometown app, designed to help migrants send money back home.

Gravity is a cloud-based SaaS company offering a suite of modular apps for enterprises to gain real-time visibility into their supply chain. Clients get a dashboard with updated information on where each product is in any part of the supply chain.
Easy Inspection is a mobile first inspection reporting & maintenance tracking (work order management) solution for property managers.

Groundup.ai is an industrial predictive maintenance software platform powered with proprietary AI sound and vibration analytics and prosensor hardware. It prevents costly downtime and critical equipment failure in heavy industries.
Growsari is an online platform that connects sari-sari stores (mom-and-pops) directly to manufacturers, allowing store owners to double their product margins compared to the traditional supply chain.

GudangAda is Indonesia’s largest and fastest-growing B2B FMCG e-Commerce platform, empowering stakeholders across the value chain with Faster, Cheaper, Smarter and Bigger transactions through technology.
Gushcloud is a web and mobile social network to collect and share their opinions on music, movies, online articles and pictures
Hardskills is an online platform that helps enterprises train their workforce in essential human behavioural skills, such as collaboration, critical thinking, agility, and sales influence.

Hati Health is transforming women’s healthcare in the Philippines with its comprehensive and inclusive wellness platform that tackles major barriers such as high costs and cultural challenges, making healthcare more accessible for women.
Healint provides a patient centric health platform to help healthcare systems better manage chronic conditions and solve the lack of good quality data problem in the development of treatments.

HealthTrip specialises in facilitating medical tourism for international patients, offering end-to-end support for booking treatments, travel arrangements, and accommodations to ensure a seamless healthcare experience.

Heyy is positioned as a personal guide to mental health and wellbeing, encompassing (1) a “listening” space with trained listeners (or Helpers as they call it) (2) a set of personalized self-help tools, and (3) specialized care with “experts” on a need-based basis.
Hipvan is an online store for thoughtfully designed, well-made home furnishings at honest prices to help consumers create their own inspiring home.

HR Tech is an automated and digitised platform designed to match blue-collar workers with the best-fit job opportunities. It enhances the entire human resource experience, from job discovery to employee management.

Hum Capital is a funding platform that connects companies with investors and financiers, making it easier to secure funding. By analysing a company’s financial performance through automated tools, the platform recommends investment opportunities to capital providers.

Hydroleap provides high-performance, chemical-free, and modularised electrochemical technologies for wastewater and hard water treatment. Their modular systems replace traditional energy-intensive and chemical-heavy processes.

ICON revolutionises construction through 3D printing, robotics, and advanced materials. This approach creates a paradigm shift in the construction industry, improving construction speed, cost-efficiency, and overall project delivery.

Igloohome is a leader in secure access management for smart properties, serving a range of customers from large-scale industries to individual homes. They design keyless, contactless solutions that operate remotely without WiFi, enabling smarter living and cities.

Existing battery technologies have low lifetimes, toxic, are expensive and slow to charge. Involt brings a new approach to electricity storage by using safe supercapacitors with 200x longer lifetimes and 100x faster charging speeds, with the aim of making traditionally large supercapacitors smaller over time to progressively replace batteries by application.

Iterative Health is a computer vision analytics platform that leverages machine learning and AI to augment physician judgment, improving global standards for gastrointestinal care and the prevension/diagnosis of colorectal cancer.
Jumper facilitates social commerce, enabling brands and enterprises to sell directly through social media using hashtags and direct conversations, uplifting conversion rates for online sales.
Juvo Labs produces Juvo, a sleep and vitals monitor, to new parents and the elderly

Kalibrr’s AI-powered Talent Marketplace captures data which fuels job discovery and automated talent sourcing allowing companies to acquire the most relevant job applications and engage immediately on their platform.

Kiddo Health provides a comprehensive hardware and software solution that simplifies pediatric healthcare by offering health record management, personalised recommendations, educational resources, and communication tools to improve collaboration between parents and healthcare providers.

Klikit is a software designed to help kitchens increase sales and optimise operations. Dubbed as the ‘Toast for Asia,’ Klikit aims to become the ‘all-in-one’ vertical operating system for restaurants, bars, and hotels across the region.

Komunidad is an Environmental Intelligence Platform that enables local governments and businesses to make informed decisions about safety, operational efficiency, business continuity, and natural disaster preparedness.

Konigle is an AI-powered website builder platform helping merchants create high-performance websites. It comes with a suite of tools for search optimisation, workflow automation, and effective management of pricing, sales, conversions, and accounts.

KrASIA is a digital media company reporting on technology-driven trends and startups in the Asia-Pacific region, providing insights into innovations and market developments within the startup ecosystem.
Kyklo is a product data management and sales enablement tool for wholesale distributors.
Laconik is optimizing yield and profit by enabling farmers to apply nitrogen fertilizer at a variable rate through the proprietary algorithms developed over 20 years of research and data.

Language Confidence uses AI technology to monitor, personalize, and improve students’ progress through the use of speech recognition, correction, and suggestive pronunciation, empowering companies to fill the lack of effective spoken English teaching & testing.
Lauretta is a behavioural AI security solution that uses feed from existing low-resolution CCTV cameras to predict human behaviour and intent, preventing crimes before they happen.

Lemnis is solving VR sickness (Visual fatigue, blurred/double vision, headache, dizziness, nausea etc.) by tackling the sensory conflicts between vergence and accommodation (naturally occurring reactions in eyes) caused by the artificial environment that the eyes are exposed to in VR headsets.

Lemonaide offers SaaS solutions designed to help used car dealers sell their cars at true value. Their platform focuses on keeping up with industry standards in terms of inspections, transparency, sales management, and after-sales service.

Lhoopa is at the forefront of addressing the affordable housing backlog in the Philippines by building homes on a large scale. The company uses a unique blend of technology and processes to orchestrate decentralised operations, all without requiring Lhoopa’s on-ground presence.

LiveIn is a marketplace that tackles the affordable housing shortage in SEA by transforming properties into affordable rental homes. Their tech-driven, asset-light model allows them to scale quickly, offering flexible leases in the region.
Luxola is an online platform selling skincare and cosmetic products to consumers in Southeast Asia.

Lynk addresses the challenge of accessing niche expertise by connecting users with experts across various industries for content, such as Q&A sessions, providing them specialised insights, opinions, and advice.
Maria Health is the first mover in the Philippines to make healthcare more affordable to SMEs and individuals via an online easy to use platform that allows buyers to compare and choose.

Meatiply is a cultured meat company focused on optimising poultry-based meat production through specialised muscle cell regeneration technology, offering a promising solution to the environmental concerns of traditional meat production.

Medcheck is a clinical data and EMR platform for specialists in emerging markets, enabling doctors to use empirical data for patient diagnosis while conducting clinical trials for pharmaceutical companies.
Media Loyal is a platform that bridges loyalty programs with online businesses.

Medici provides affordable insurance and healthcare service. With a network of 22,000 advisors and a comprehensive technology platform, it helps customers find the best plans, track claims, and manage all policies with ease.

Medicia provides an integrated platform for healthcare providers and oncology patients, capturing all patient data and tracking treatment journeys. This enables the creation of personalised care plans and allows for the extraction of anonymised data for research purposes.
Medo is an AI-Augmented 3D platform that radically simplifies the use of ultrasound for common and critical conditions.
Meiro is a Customer Data Platform (CDP) that helps businesses consolidate, manage, and analyse their customer data from multiple sources into a single, unified customer profile.

MFast is Vietnam’s leading financial services distribution network. It offers a range of services, from digital account activation and installment loans (for home appliances) to unsecured loans–all distributed through their extensive agent network.

MicroSec provides enterprise-grade security for IoT, IIoT, and OT devices and networks using their proprietary micro-certificates. Their solutions enable real-time monitoring, protection, and management across both greenfield and brownfield environments.

MindX is a coding school in Vietnam that aims to build a comprehensive ecosystem for tech talent, covering everything from education to co-working spaces. It has grown to become Southeast Asia’s leading ecosystem for technology education.

Moka provides an end-to-end POS and payment solution that caters specifically to Indonesian SMEs, the POS is easy to install and use, requires minimal training and set up, and offers dynamic and robust information to its users, allowing them to elevate their business
Mushroom Material creates an eco-friendly alternative to Expanded Polystyrene (EPS), also known as styrofoam, using 95% upcycled organic waste material bonded by proprietary mycelium technology.
Musiio has built an AI that can “listen” to music, supercharging Sync Companies, Labels, Streaming Services and more to make their large catalogues of music infinitely more searchable.

MyDoc is a secure digital care platform which integrates healthcare verticals seamlessly while providing a simple chat interface for patients and healthcare providers, boosting patient follow-up rates from 10% to 80% after implementation, reducing costs and helping insurers and policy holders take a proactive approach to healthcare.

Daatrics is producing a series of wearable products, starting with the Neebo. The Neebo is a miniature infant wearable monitor which addresses the most prominent parental fears by tracking the baby’s vitals, activity and sound data to notify parents and carers about an infant’s wellbeing.
Nemesis is a social, multi-game mobile gaming platform where players can compete synchronously in real-time matches.

Neocrete is disrupting the construction industry with high-performing, low-carbon concrete by replacing up to 40% of cement with the Neocrete Activator and pozzolans. This innovation significantly reduces the carbon footprint of construction projects while enhancing resilience to climate change.

NirogStreet empowers Ayurveda doctors with knowledge updates, streamlined supply procurement with a multi-brand medicine marketplace, and a certified smart clinic solution that facilitates medicine delivery to patients.

Noneaway is a closed marketplace designed exclusively for licensed real estate brokers to connect and transact, particularly in the secondary market. It aims to make transactions safer, more secure, and efficient for both home buyers and brokers.

Novade is a cloud-based construction management platform that streamlines project management and enhances collaboration across teams. It offers tools for managing project workflows, quality control, safety, and documentation.

Nugit empowers enterprises to unlock the full potential of their data assets. Their AI-powered Data Storytelling platform transforms raw data into compelling narratives, driving faster, data-driven decisions that deliver real business impact.

Oddle is Singapore’s leading hyper-growth e-commerce enabler for the F&B industry, offering a one-stop, white-label SaaS solution for online ordering and food delivery. Their re-launched Oddle Eats directory efficiently connects merchants with consumers.
Ohai.ai is an AI-powered family assistant designed to reduce the mental burden of Chief Household Officers by simplifying family communication and task management.

Omnistream leverages operational data and external factors to generate product recommendations for retailers, helping them capitalise on trends through easy-to-understand inventory lists and planograms.

One Team looks to acquire and scale SMEs in Southeast Asia by creating a super ecosystem of cash-flow-positive businesses in evergreen industries through digitisation, operational improvements, and strategic financing.
OpenPort improves the transport and procurement process by using digital electronic proof of delivery (ePOD) to validate driver disputes and improve cashflow for enterprises.

Oraan leverages gamified onboarding and ROSCAs (informal peer-to-peer lending groups) to help women in Pakistan build credit history and gain access to formal financial services, introducing them to social banking designed specifically for women.
OY! is an all-in-one payment aggregator with cash processing services connected to a cashless ecosystem.
Panalyt bridges the People-Data Gap and improves business performance through data-driven people decisions.
PasTech is a dual-sided proptech play with (i) iBuying for sellers and (ii) rent-to-own for buyers, centered on a proprietary Automated Value Model (AVM).
Pencil is the world’s first generative creative SaaS platform that uses AI to generate advertising language and visuals that are predicted to be creative, effective, and on-brand.

Perform.AI is the AI Commerce Operating System for ambitious brands. It runs the whole e-commerce journey, from a brand being found to the parcel being delivered, on one system, for the people who buy and the AI agents that support them. The system runs on more than 100 billion parcel updates a year for thousands of brands, with more than 1,100 carrier integrations in more than 160 countries. Founded in 2016 as Parcel Perform, the company became Perform.AI in September 2026.

Pi-xcels is an NFC-enabled platform that allows merchants to issue paperless, interactive e-receipts in stores, with a simple tap of a smartphone. It also captures real-time data, providing detailed transaction insights.
Pie is a team communication platform for enterprise clients.

Pilon specialises in supply chain financing solutions, helping businesses optimise their cash flow. Their platform ensures suppliers receive immediate payments while allowing buyers extended payment terms, improving overall cash conversion cycles.

Pitik empowers chicken farmers throughout the entire value chain by providing high quality inputs and IoT to optimize the variables within a chicken farm, increasing yield and decreasing mortality rate.
Pixel Canvas is an enterprise metaverse builder that helps brands create immersive virtual experiences, fostering deeper customer engagement and brand loyalty.

Portcast uses AI and machine learning to accurately track containers, predict ETAs, and provide port terminal visibility for imports and exports. This data-driven approach helps improve margins for freight forwarders and shipping lines by delivering actionable insights.
Poseidon Fund is a venture-builder fund by 01 VC.

PQCEE helps businesses and governments globally address security risks posed by quantum computing advancements. Their solutions ensure that data remains private and secure, even as quantum computing becomes accessible to bad actors such as hackers.

Privyr is a mobile app designed to help salespeople manage their leads and client communications more effectively. It integrates with lead generation sources, CRM systems, and communication platforms, offering features for content management, tracking, and follow-ups.
Qore is a cloud-based Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) platform for enterprises, specialising in foundational data powered by Machine Learning and Robotics Process Automation (ML/RPA).
DatastreamX is an online marketplace for real-time data streams, including those from IoT, M2M and Big Data Applications.
Red Dot Payment provides customised payment gateway solutions in Asia Pacific for merchants of all sizes at competitive rates.

Relativity Space leverages its proprietary 3D printing technology (Stargate 3D printer) to design, build, and launch rockets into orbit for commercial and government organisations at a fraction of the cost and time of competitors.
Revenium is a B2B API platform that empowers enterprises to monetise existing underutilised datasets by turning them into API-backed products–without requiring support from engineering teams.

Ricult uses data analytic tools to support the agriculture industry, providing farmers access to financial products, market information, and high-quality inputs. Services include credit profiling, advisory, and input financing.

Runn is a software solution designed to help managers with resource management and employee profitability. It offers real-time data on resource utilisation, project timelines, and budget comparisons for accurate profitability forecasting.
SalesCandy is a lead management system built for large enterprises’ fragmented salesforce that enables salespeople to act on leads within 5 minutes, and ultimately close more sales.
Saleswhale has built an AI Assistant that helps businesses convert more leads into qualified opportunities and sales pipeline, thereby driving growth in revenue and marketing ROI.
Savonix is the first mobile, consumer-friendly, clinically valid tool to screen for cognitive decline with the aim to build the largest dataset for cognitive decline worldwide.

Senseye is at the forefront of neurotechnology with its proprietary Emotional Intelligence Engine (EIE), which analyses ocular data to provide insights into trauma-related conditions and potential applications for substance abuse.
Sentons is a fabless semiconductor company developing multi-touch sensors that support a wide range of glass and metal substrates.
Serve is developing autonomous sidewalk delivery robots. This innovation reduces the need for larger delivery vehicles, which in turn reduces labor costs while also being more sustainable.

SHIELD provides a device-first fraud prevention and risk intelligence platform that focuses on identifying and blocking fraudulent activities. By leveraging device intelligence and AI, SHIELD analyses and trusts device signals to detect fraud.

Shikho is a Bangladeshi edutech company that provides a full-suite learning experience with a platform for on-demand resources, in-app practice questions, live classes, and offline experience centres.

Shipmates provides software designed for last-mile and middle-mile logistic players to manage their orders efficiently. They also assist online businesses in booking shipments in bulk with local and international couriers across the Philippines.
Silent Eight is a cybersecurity technology solution leveraging AI to combat financial crimes, such as money laundering and terrorist financing, for the world’s leading financial institutions.

Sirka is a digital health mobile app that aims to tackle obesity and metabolic health issues in Indonesia through personalised plans, including nutritionist guidance, curated food marketplace, and referrals to clinics.

Skycatch provides advanced aerial data capture, real-time 3D mapping, and analytics solutions for the construction, mining, and energy industries through its leading drone automation and data analysis platform.

Smartkarma is a global investment research platform that provides professionals and private investors with actionable insights, corporate IR teams with digital IR solutions, and research providers with global distribution opportunities.
Smove is a car sharing platform for consumers to rent a car for short periods. They also provide fleet management solutions for enterprises.
Snapcart applies proprietary AI to connect Brands and Customers through real-time data and purchase attributions

Soul Parking offers advanced parking management solutions aimed at optimising urban space utilisation with minimal human intervention in Indonesia. Their services include digital parking systems for various properties, as well as their vertical parking solution, Soul Parking Tower.
SourceSage is an online store builder and white-label solutions provider for B2B eCommerce. It connects large buyers with small sellers to streamline digital marketplace creation and management.

Spiralytics offers a SaaS product that integrates data from all of the customer’s marketing platforms into a single, easy-to-use dashboard. This way, users can access real-time information to assess and track their marketing channels and take immediate action.

Sprout offers a localised HR/Payroll solution designed for the emerging markets, addressing the unique challenges of government regulations and market nuances. This enables HR departments to digitise their operations end-to-end.
Stacck is a software platform that helps food and beverage managers organize their business through better internal communication and messaging.

Staple develops cognitive AI to read, interpret, and extract structured data from documents at scale, regardless of layout or language. Using deep learning, they automate document workflows to help businesses save time and money, and reduce errors.

Structo designs, develops and builds 3D printers that are able to print 5-10x faster using their proprietary MSLA technology, and also develops their own materials with the first use cases tailored for dental applications such as aligners and implants.

Stylist in Pocket pivoted from free styling services to an easy to use platform to manage uniforms and corporate gifts and supplies. They have pivoted again into the Web3 space by creating a Premiere Art NFT Launchpad in Asia called Scarletbox.

TablePointer offers specialised solutions for energy efficiency in the food and beverage industry. Their tools provide real-time monitoring and analysis of energy use, helping businesses optimise consumption and reduce costs.
TAC Index is the leading global provider of air freight data, aggregating air cargo prices for merchants and shippers across all categories of goods and international trade routes.
Taidii is a school management platform that enhances operational efficiency, tracks child development, and fosters better parent-teacher communication in early childhood education centres.
Tessaract is a B2B SaaS platform designed to automate workflows for the professional services industry, with a core focus on Law and Accounting.

The Clinician is a value-based SaaS healthcare platform focused on improving healthcare outcomes, enhancing organisational efficiency, and reducing costs by analysing Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROMs).

Tiger New Energy provides a lithium-powered battery infrastructure for rickshaw drivers in Bangladesh, offering a convenient and affordable battery-swapping system that brings multiple benefits, including unlimited swaps and increased income.

Tour Amigo provides a complete software and API solution that powers the entire back-end operations for multi-day tour operators. This means seamless connectivity for distribution, internal processes, and supply-side coordination and bookings.
TradeGecko is an inventory, sales and order management platform that enables SME wholesalers and distributors to manage their entire businesses sales & supply chains in one SaaS solution.

Transcelestial is pioneering “wireless fiber optics,” delivering fiber-like speeds through laser technology, which offers secure, high-speed last-mile connectivity at a fraction of the deployment time and cost compared to traditional fiber.
uHoo provides the most comprehensive indoor air quality monitoring solution, catering primarily to commercial real estate developers and owners seeking WELL certification.

UpPass is a no-code platform unifying localised data verification, fraud detection, and credit scoring for businesses in Southeast Asia. It helps companies ensure compliance, mitigate online fraud, and automate user verification and account opening processes.
Upshot is an HR tech company built to improve the onboarding and training of front line managers within the F&B and BPO industries.
Valtec offers a managed drone service powered by proprietary software and AI to transform marine intelligence, focusing on purse-seine fishing vessels to improve efficiency and sustainability.
Vama digitises the spiritual practices of the Indian population, offering convenient access to astrologers, temples, daily prayers, and virtual pujas.

Verihubs provides a fast, data-driven solution for online identity verification. Their authentication APIs integrate various verification methods, including facial recognition and OTP, to verify identities in under 5 seconds, helping businesses improve delivery and conversion rates.

VFlowTech designs and manufactures safe, durable, high-performing, and cost-efficient vanadium flow batteries for large-scale energy storage. With proprietary technology, VFlowTech provides innovative solutions for efficient long-term energy management.

Vidtech provides video services tailored for the commercial real estate (CRE) industry, offering innovative tools for sales, marketing, and property inspections. Their flagship products include Videom for property marketing, and Vidspection for audits and inspections.

Vigo Retail aims to democratise access to FMCG goods, empowering agents, brands, and retailers through an innovative distribution platform. The goal is to expand the market and maximise the income potential of social-selling agents.
VIPdiskon is platform that offers e-commerce shoppers in Indonesia the ability to receive discounts and cashback for their online purchases.

watchTowr offers an attack surface management solution that provides enterprises real-time, continuous visibility of their digital vulnerabilities, helping them minimise cybersecurity risks effectively.
Wavecell enables enterprises to communicate with customers via SMS and video using programatic APIs.
WeBuy is a social commerce platform transforming the way consumers shop for groceries through leveraging the new norms of consumer sharing and interacting via group chats and social networks.
Wiz enhances call centres with AI-powered Talkbots capable of handling significantly more calls than human agents, while delivering consistent service quality.
Wobe provides financial services to low income women in emerging markets by allowing them to start a small business selling phone airtime.

Wootag is an interactive video platform that allows viewers to engage directly with brands within the video itself. It enables in-video purchases and interactions, enhancing user engagement across various social media platforms and channels.

Workmate’s online staffing platform transforms the way businesses hire and manage blue collar workers, with powerful technology that automates the sourcing, screening and scheduling of thousands of reliable workers in our curated network.

WriterZen initially launched as an all-in-one SEO platform but later pivoted to create Allapi–an API hub that allows developers to seamlessly integrate the latest AI models into their products using multiple programming languages with auto-updates included.

XSQUARE is a leading provider of intelligent warehousing solutions based in Singapore, specialising in autonomous guided vehicles (AGVs) and warehouse management systems (WMS) tailored for high-density warehouses.

Yulu offers an affordable solution for people and goods mobility through its tech-enabled platform and smart electric bikes, addressing commuters’ first and last-mile travel needs while also supporting efficient last-mile deliveries.
Zap offers a white labeled mobile-based loyalty platform providing retailers with an incredibly easy to set-up solution with automated marketing and real time data analytics.
Zero2.5 provides fresh, clean air through its Negative Air Ions (NAIs) emission system, which provides up to 10x the concentration of NAIs of conventional ionizers.

Zilingo is the largest B2B commerce platform across ASEAN – merchants across categories can source faster and cheaper with Zilingo’s B2B Marketplace, while digitizing their business processes with Zilingo’s end-to-end services.

Zipline is a compliance management platform for healthcare and aged care facilities. By automating evidence collection, verification, and reporting, it simplifies the compliance processes for visitors, employees, and contractors.

ZuBlu is the leading travel platform to book scuba diving and ocean experiences in Asia and beyond. With over 500+ eco-friendly resorts and liveaboards to choose from, guests can travel green while exploring the blue.
Zumata provides hotel inventory to online travel agencies (OTAs) and build AI chat bots.

Zuno Carbon is a climate platform designed to help asset-heavy businesses manage and reduce their carbon footprint. Their solution automates emissions tracking, provides data-driven insights, supporting the development of decarbonisation strategies.

Their all-in-one hotel operating system, paired with dedicated revenue managers, optimises pricing, promotions, and distribution strategies. ZUZU acts as an extension of hotel teams, working year-round to maximise their potential.
Zyllem is an enterprise SaaS platform that allows companies to plan, manage, operate, and track their entire logistics and delivery network.
